scope: Output addresses of every actual grid program and lane are within M*N without a K-loop index or positive-K premise. This applies also when K=0.
Output address equality across all launched program/lane coordinates determines the same program and same lane. The result is derived for the exact programState and outputOffset definitions.
No successful-run, address-equality specification, no-alias, no-overflow or numerical-law premise is used; all dimensions/block sizes remain natural model parameters.
remaining_nondeferrable_gaps: The natural address facts do not bind native fixed-width arithmetic, byte pointers, allocation bounds or physical storage aliases.
Distinct logical output writes do not alone prove input/output separation, inter-program read/write race freedom or native instruction interleavings.
Whole wrapper caller/native-admission/allocator/metadata boundaries from the frozen batch remain open.
